rows.title: After the Hunt — Luca Guadagnino [Review]
rows.dek_lead: It’s a frigid exercise in blowing hot air. The film is steeped in the overheated trappings of tasteless, low-brow thrillers of yore, but its script also smacks of a snobbish, verbose modernity.
